summary.headline: IGI Q2 FY27 revenue rose 31% to INR 3,980 million and management now expects FY27 to beat its 15% revenue and 20% EBITDA guidance.
summary.overview: Consolidated Q2 FY27 was the company's best quarter by volume, revenue, EBITDA and profit, with 4.35 million reports issued (up 26%). Revenue from operations reached INR 3,980 million (up 31%), EBITDA INR 2,445 million (up 39%, margin 61.4%) and PAT INR 1,858 million (up 43%). H1 revenue grew 27%, EBITDA 34% and PAT 37%. Management said H2 will keep outperforming, but did not give a new numeric target. India standalone EBITDA margin fell about 340 bps to 69.5% due to people, marketing and commission spend.

segments.name: Lab-grown diamond (LGD) loose certification
segments.commentary: Consolidated LGD revenue grew 37% in Q2 and 31% in H1, at INR 2,111 million in Q2 versus INR 2,095 million in Q1. Loose LGD certification volumes grew 37%.

segments.name: LGD jewellery certification
segments.commentary: Grew 47% in Q2 and 46% in H1. Management cited growth in Europe, Latin America and Australia alongside the US.

segments.name: Natural diamond certification
segments.commentary: Natural loose certification grew 8% in Q2 (up 5% QoQ) and 7% in H1. Natural jewellery certification grew only 3% in the quarter.

segments.name: Gemstones and other certification (incl. AGL)
segments.commentary: Grew 331% in Q2 and 261% in H1, largely from the AGL consolidation since January. AGL added about 3% to group revenue growth in Q2 and H1.

segments.name: Overseas subsidiaries
segments.commentary: Subsidiary revenue grew 49% in Q2; 31% excluding AGL. Overseas certification revenue grew 31% without AGL.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance from May was 15% revenue growth and 20% EBITDA growth. Management now says it expects to outperform this for the full year, similar to H1 (revenue +27%, EBITDA +34%), but gave no new numeric target.
Management said no LGD slowdown is expected in coming quarters, citing grower capacity additions. Natural diamond business is expected to keep momentum for the next two quarters.
October trends were described as rock solid, with Diwali on 8 November 2026 versus 20 October 2025, which shifts some festive stocking into October.
Capital allocation order: growth investment first, then M&A, then dividends. Dividend decisions are made by the Board with each results set.
Management expects EBITDA growth to keep outpacing revenue growth through operating leverage, but did not give a steady-state margin figure.
capex_capacity: Large Indian growers are adding reactors and doubling capacity within 3 years, per management; supply is described as at its base rather than its peak.
Operations started in Italy this year, Saudi Arabia is being prepared, and a company was set up in Botswana in September.
AI-based work allocation and scheduling is now in use in labs, letting the same team grade more stones faster without changing grading standards.
AGL colour-stone methods are being rolled out in IGI's other labs, with dedicated setups planned for large customers. Global expansion of AGL services is planned but locations were not disclosed.
demand_pricing: Lab-grown wholesale prices have stabilised in the INR 118-120 range per management's Investor Day deck. Certification costs 2-3% of retail price.

Q2 ARP rose 4% YoY to INR 891: AGL added 2%, and the base business added 2% from a higher LGD mix (54% vs 52%). Sequentially, ARP fell about 12% on a lower LGD loose mix (down 4%) and a higher jewellery mix.
Natural diamond buyers are delaying purchases due to high and volatile gold prices.
Management said 4Cs grading remains the reporting standard and that it sees no demand shift to simplified classification. It said there are no printing rights for certificates granted to anyone.

qa_highlights.question: Is the LGD revenue surge a pre-festive stocking effect, and will Q3 taper?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said LGD revenue has been steady at about INR 2,100 million in Q1 and Q2 and expects no slowdown, citing grower capacity additions. Natural growth is expected to pick up, with traction starting and momentum expected to continue for two more quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Should guidance be raised given H1 overshoot?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said H2 will outperform the 15% revenue and 20% EBITDA guidance, similar to H1. It did not give a new number, but confirmed when asked that H2 growth would be above the original guidance.

qa_highlights.question: How will the surplus cash be used: M&A or higher dividends?
qa_highlights.answer: Priority is growth investment first (Italy, Saudi Arabia), then M&A, then dividends. The September interim dividend was INR 2.55 per share.

qa_highlights.question: Is there grading inconsistency at IGI, and are the top Surat manufacturers printing certificates?
qa_highlights.answer: Management denied giving printing rights to anyone. It said grading involves multiple checks, is ISO accredited for 18 years, and that there is no gap versus other labs.

qa_highlights.question: Does the AI push allow smaller labs to compete cheaply?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said IGI's image dataset from c.4.5 million certificates a quarter is hard to replicate and is used to build its AI and ML capability, improving turnaround times.

qa_highlights.question: Why did EBITDA margin in India fall and when will the investments pay off?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the India margin drop of about 340 bps to leadership hiring, marketing and commission spend. It gave no timeline for payback, but said the group margin was 60.1% for FY26, 60.4% in Q1 and 61.4% in Q2.

risks_watch: Natural diamond certification growth of 8% lags LGD, and natural jewellery grew only 3%. Watch whether festive-season recovery materialises.
India standalone EBITDA margin fell to 69.5% from 72.8%. Watch whether the people and marketing spend yields a return.
Diwali timing shift means some Q2 festive demand was pulled from Q3 by September stocking. Watch Q3 for payback.
AGL integration: gemstone growth is driven by acquisition and the organic base is not disclosed. Watch the AGL contribution and the global rollout.
Grading consistency questions were raised by a市场 participant and a Surat source. Management denied them. Monitor for any disputes or customer complaints.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on growth and tailwinds, but evasive on quantifying the new FY27 target and on Surat grading and printing-rights questions. Management pushed back on pricing and competition questions with general statements rather than data.
key_quotes: This has been the best quarter in IGI's history.
We expect to keep outperforming for the full year as well, similar to the H1 delivery.
We don't anticipate any slowdown as far as lab-grown business is concerned for the coming quarters as well.

growth.why: Management now expects FY27 revenue and EBITDA growth to outperform the May guidance (15% revenue, 20% EBITDA) and to be similar to H1 (~27% revenue, ~34% EBITDA), but gave no new numeric target; backing is partial, citing grower capacity additions, overseas lab start-ups (Italy live, Saudi and Botswana planned), AGL roll-out and ARP/LGD mix, without quantified capacity.
